title: Northloop Protect Plans Settlement Standards: Claim Limits, Replacement Triggers, Valuation and Reversal Reasons
content:
The settlement standards of the Northloop Protect Plans are the same on all six plans. The total claim settlements allowed over a plan are capped at the covered item price, and the most one claim may pay is the covered item price less settlements already paid. An estimated repair above 80 per cent (0.8) of the covered item price is replaced instead, and so is the next qualifying claim after 3 completed repairs for the same failure. A replacement is valued at like kind and quality up to the covered item price; where no replacement is available the reimbursement is paid by Northloop gift card; and a replacement or reimbursement fulfils and ends the plan.

## Limits and plan ending

| Plan | Total settlements allowed over the plan | Most one claim may pay | Replacement or reimbursement fulfils and ends the plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | Covered item price | Covered item price less settlements paid | Yes |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | Covered item price | Covered item price less settlements paid | Yes |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | Covered item price | Covered item price less settlements paid | Yes |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | Covered item price | Covered item price less settlements paid | Yes |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | Covered item price | Covered item price less settlements paid | Yes |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | Covered item price | Covered item price less settlements paid | Yes |

## Replacement triggers and valuation

| Plan | Repair-cost replace threshold (share of covered item price) | Completed repairs for the same failure before the next qualifying claim is replaced | Replacement valued at | Reimbursement paid by, when no replacement is available |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | 0.8 (80 per cent) | 3 | Like kind and quality up to the covered item price | Northloop gift card |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | 0.8 (80 per cent) | 3 | Like kind and quality up to the covered item price | Northloop gift card |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | 0.8 (80 per cent) | 3 | Like kind and quality up to the covered item price | Northloop gift card |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | 0.8 (80 per cent) | 3 | Like kind and quality up to the covered item price | Northloop gift card |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | 0.8 (80 per cent) | 3 | Like kind and quality up to the covered item price | Northloop gift card |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | 0.8 (80 per cent) | 3 | Like kind and quality up to the covered item price | Northloop gift card |

## Reasons a paid settlement is reversed

| Plan | Reversal reasons |
|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | Voided gift card, duplicate payment |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | Voided gift card, duplicate payment |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | Voided gift card, duplicate payment |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | Voided gift card, duplicate payment |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | Voided gift card, duplicate payment |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | Voided gift card, duplicate payment |

## Figures worked on hypothetical inputs

- Covered item price 500.00 USD: the replace threshold is 80 per cent of 500.00, that is 400.00 USD.
- Covered item price 800.00 USD with 300.00 USD of settlements already paid: the most the next claim may pay is 800.00 less 300.00, that is 500.00 USD, and the total settlements over the plan can never pass 800.00 USD.
